chunks: Muhammad ibn Musa ibn al-Mutevakil (may God be pleased with him) narrated that Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar quoted on the authority of Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya ibn Imran al-Ash’ari, who said: He narrated to me Abu Abdillah Al-Jamoorani, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Abi Hamzah, from As-Sayf ibn Umayrah, from Al-Mansur ibn Hazim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said: The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said:
The companionship of religious people is the honor of this world and the Hereafter.
ai.seo_question: What is the benefit of keeping company with religious people according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Al-Khisal*, this hadith links the Prophet’s saying to Imam al-Sadiq, highlighting the Shia emphasis on *suhba* (spiritual companionship) as a means of acquiring *sharaf* (honor). It underscores the practical implication that righteous social circles serve as a protective shield against moral decline while elevating one's status in both dunya and akhira.
